rule: The history script names only existing nodes and shop items, its steps are in chronological order between the join day and yesterday, and every step is one the live start rules allow: a lesson plays the current node's next lesson.

cases.name: unknown-node
cases.expect: sample_learner.json › steps[0]: there is no node 'u9.nowhere' in the learner's course

cases.name: unknown-shop-item
cases.expect: sample_learner.json › steps[12] › purchase › item: Input should be 'heart_refill', 'unlimited_hearts', 'streak_freeze' or 'xp_boost_15'

cases.name: item-not-for-sale
cases.expect: sample_learner.json › steps[12]: the shop doesn't sell unlimited_hearts

cases.name: steps-out-of-order
cases.expect: sample_learner.json: steps[2] must come after the step before it

cases.name: step-before-joining
cases.expect: sample_learner.json: steps[0] must happen after the learner joined (day -30, noon)

cases.name: step-on-the-seed-day
cases.expect: sample_learner.json: steps[25] must happen before the seed day (day -1 or earlier)

cases.name: lesson-on-a-locked-node
cases.expect: sample_learner.json › steps[3]: this lesson would be refused with NODE_LOCKED

cases.name: lesson-on-a-completed-node
cases.expect: sample_learner.json › steps[3]: this lesson would be refused with NODE_ALREADY_COMPLETED

cases.name: chest-not-reachable
cases.expect: sample_learner.json › steps[6]: u2.chest is not a reachable chest

cases.name: practice-before-any-lesson
cases.expect: sample_learner.json › steps[0]: this practice would be refused with NOTHING_TO_PRACTICE

cases.name: purchase-without-enough-gems
cases.expect: sample_learner.json › steps[12]: streak_freeze costs 200 gems, the learner has 120

cases.name: wrong-item-beyond-the-lesson
cases.expect: sample_learner.json › steps[0] › wrong: the session has at most 6 items, so not [7]

cases.name: failed-legendary-run
cases.expect: sample_learner.json › steps[20] › legendary › wrong: a legendary run fails after 2 mistakes
